note: Machine-readable form of docs/PORT_3DS_CONSOLE_RUNBOOK.md. Run it with tools/port3ds/console_session/session.py (see the runbook, 'Unattended session'). 'session.py export-loop' writes the static run steps as a plain `devupdate.py loop` manifest. Every run step is one `devupdate.py loop` entry (the supervisor pushes, launches, watches the heartbeat; the PC reads latest.log). Step fields: id, type (run|cmd|baseline|bisect|restore), phase, cia (key of 'cias': push this CIA first), switches ({VAR} expands from 'vars'; the driver adds hwb=<id>-<attempt> unless tag=false), until (regex on latest.log, wrapped to start at the tag), frames, timeout_s, watch, expect (regexes that must all match), fail_on (regexes that must not match), expect_crash (a crash or recovery screen is the pass), retries (extra attempts), retry_drop (switch words removed from attempt 2 on), collect (app files), collect_dirs (app folders, fetched whole), gate (see below), optional, destructive, manual (what the owner must watch). gate: {probe: [cases], result: OK} reads the newest gpuprobe.txt; {step_ok: id}; {file: path}. Recovery policy: after a failed attempt the driver calls `supervisor terminate --gpureset 2`, retries up to 'retries' times, then records the failure and goes on with the next step; when the supervisor stops answering the driver waits for it (reboot window), and stops the session with exit 2 and a resume state only if it never comes back.

dry.note: The dry-run profile (session.py run --dry azahar|fake): the same steps with short scenes, windows 61/121, and a cut-down list. 'azahar' runs against an azahar-session behind azsv.py (the real game, no console); 'fake' runs against fakegame.py (host-only, drills the failure paths and the bisect). A2c (the probe dies at rt_deleted) needs a process death Azahar cannot take, so only 'fake' has it.
